value.title: Implement runtime-specific model catalogs
value.summary: One phase: test, implement, verify, and prepare the branch.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Add failing coverage for runtime-specific model catalogs, implement OMP effective-catalog parsing and runtime selection, remove context-collapsing overrides, then prove with targeted tests, static gates, live selectors, and the full harness gate.

value.title: Add RED catalog and validation tests
value.success: Tests fail for missing Sol Fast, OMP variants, exact selectors, honest load failure, and runtime-specific spawn validation.
value.notes: No broad mocks; inject command execution only at the OMP process boundary.

value.title: Implement runtime-aware catalog model
value.success: Model entries carry runtime, upstream provider, and exact selector; Copilot and OMP inventories are distinct.
value.notes: Use omp models --json --no-extensions; never refresh or read SQLite.
value.receipt: registry/CLI tests 82 passed; live OMP eight-variant projection observed

value.title: Wire runtime-specific CLI and spawn validation
value.success: models filtering and spawn/effort warnings select Copilot, OMP, or Pi catalog by target runtime while Claude/Codex remain unchanged.
value.receipt: runtime validation tests 13 passed; OMP spawn integration 2 passed

value.title: Remove context-collapsing OMP overrides and verify
value.success: Only committed GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol/Terra overrides are removed or narrowed; targeted tests, typecheck, lint, checks, and live selector probes pass.
value.notes: Do not import the canonical checkout's uncommitted local provider.
value.receipt: harness checks: 8/8 sensors pass; live Copilot and OMP projections pass

value.title: Resolve independent model-catalog review findings
value.success: OMP efforts parse live arrays, probes are bounded, catalogs fail honestly, provider filters remain compatible, malformed inventories fail whole, domain contracts are current, and all gates pass.
value.notes: Review re-entry for FIX_REQUIRED findings F001-F006.
value.receipt: 83 pure assertions and 49 filtered integration assertions pass; Dim-0 RED/GREEN; typecheck, lint, and harness checks 8/8 pass

tk-1061.assertion: Targeted tests demonstrably fail before implementation and pass after it.

tk-1062.assertion: Copilot API IDs and OMP client selectors remain separate with measured contexts.

tk-1063.assertion: Each spawn target validates against its own runtime catalog without blocking spawn.

tk-1064.assertion: Static, targeted, full, and live gates pass and branch is pushed.

tk-1065.assertion: All six independent-review findings are fixed with focused, mutation, static, full-harness, and updated domain-contract proof.
